title: Expense Tracker App
description: An offline-first expense manager with a Flutter + Riverpod frontend and a Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL backend. Includes JWT authentication, expense CRUD with categories and search, receipt image upload, push notifications and dark mode.

title: Expense Tracker API
tagline: Backend — REST API for the Expense Tracker
description: The Node.js and Express REST API behind the Expense Tracker app: JWT authentication, expense CRUD, receipt image uploads through Cloudinary and push notifications via Firebase Admin, backed by PostgreSQL.

title: Job Portal API
description: A REST API for a job portal covering user authentication, job postings, job applications and saved jobs, built with Express and Sequelize on PostgreSQL, with file uploads and email support.

title: Resume Builder AI API
description: An Express backend for a resume builder that uses the Google Gemini API to generate a professional summary, polished skills and experience bullet points from a user's details, with automatic retries on failure.

title: Intern Management System
description: A role-based app where interns track assigned tasks and progress on a personal dashboard, while admins add interns, assign tasks and monitor team-wide stats in real time. Responsive across mobile, tablet and web.

title: Task Tracker App
description: A task management app for interns and admins with role-based access, real-time task status updates, admin task assignment, progress reports with charts and local notifications.

title: Feedback & Review App
description: A role-based feedback app — users submit ratings and reviews, while admins get a live dashboard with average ratings and a rating-distribution chart, all synced in real time through Firestore.

title: LMS Learning App
description: A Flutter learning management app with Firebase authentication, real-time course listings from Firestore, an integrated video player, and interactive quizzes with real-time scoring and progress tracking.

title: AI-Powered Fire Prevention & Alert System
description: A zone-based fire detection system combining IoT sensors, YOLOv8 image recognition, and an Android app. Sends Twilio SMS alerts in real time and logs sensor data to Firebase.

title: Notes App
description: A secure notes app with Firebase Authentication and real-time Firestore sync, live search, image attachments, swipe-to-delete with confirmation, and a dark/light mode that is remembered between sessions.

title: Weather Forecast App
description: A weather app with a condition-based interface: city search, temperature, feels-like, humidity and wind, weather icons and gradients, error handling, recent searches and pull-to-refresh, using the Open-Meteo API.

title: Student Profile App
description: A profile app with a splash screen and sections for skills, education, projects and tappable contact links, plus a light/dark theme that is remembered between sessions.

title: Weatherly
description: A modern Flutter weather app with city search, real-time temperature and conditions, a splash screen and a clean, responsive interface.
